_meta.purpose: Defines all user journeys and their CCC audit state. Single source of truth for audit progress. Claude reads and updates every session.
_meta.claudeSessionRule: On session start: start with currentAuditJourney. If that journey is not CERT-SEALED and not explicitly CERT-BLOCKED by a documented code gap, continue that same journey from lastAuditedAction + 1 or from the recorded remaining sealing blocker. Do not switch to another journey for breadth, convenience, or timeboxing. Update this file after EVERY action. Never end session without updating.
_meta.lifecycleRule: Before asking for any operator action or artifact build, Claude must state which lifecycle phase is active from CLAUDE_CURRENT_STATE.productionGradeCertificationModel.liveTestingLifecycle. Baseline live discovery and post-fix runtime certification are different phases and may not be conflated.
_meta.depthFirstAuditRule: One journey at a time, to 100% completion. Claude may move currentAuditJourney only when the current journey is CERT-SEALED, or when it is CERT-BLOCKED with exact blocker, requiredFix, and next-resume conditions documented in repo truth. 'Round not enough' is not a valid reason to switch journeys.
_meta.roundBudgetRule: If a session ends mid-journey, Claude records exact remaining blockers and next action, then resumes the same journey next session. Claude does not start sampling the next journey while the active one is still auditable.

sealingBlockers.B1_openGapsBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if openGaps array is non-empty.
sealingBlockers.B2_invariantBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if any touched invariant with blockingForSeal=true has status != VERIFIED in INVARIANT_REGISTRY.json.
sealingBlockers.B3_regressionGuardBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if any knownIssue in any screen in scope has regressionGuardStatus != PASS in SCREEN_CERT_MANIFEST.json.
sealingBlockers.B4_unsignedGuaranteeBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if any of G1-G6 has signed=false.
sealingBlockers.B5_unseededStateBlock: Runtime evidence cannot be collected if seededStateLock.confirmed=false.
sealingBlockers.B6_incompleteLevelsBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if any action has any level with status=GAP and gap is not documented as ACCEPTED_RISK with explicit justification.
sealingBlockers.B7_issueOmissionBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if any known issue in the project (LIVE_TESTING_ISSUES, SCREEN_CERT_MANIFEST knownIssues) touching any file in scopeFiles is absent from the journey's knownIssues array. Every scoped-file issue must be explicitly present and have a regressionLock entry.
sealingBlockers.B8_incompleteActionSpineBlock: No journey may move to CERT-IN-PROGRESS unless actions.length > 0 with real action decomposition. No journey may reach CERT-SEALED unless every declared action has result=PASS.
sealingBlockers.B9_weakCrossPortalBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if any crossPortalMatrix row has verified=true but is missing verifiedSha, citations[], or at least one runtimeEvidence entry. A row may be marked verified=true only when all four of: verifiedAt, verifiedSha, citations[], and runtimeEvidence[] are populated.
sealingBlockers.B10_mixedCommitBoundaryBlock: Journey cannot reach CERT-SEALED if any known issue in scope was fixed by a code commit that also modified RELEASES/, workflow/state/, or RELEASES/LIVE_TESTING_ISSUES.md, unless an explicit cluster-level exception is documented in CLAUDE_CURRENT_STATE.gitDisciplineEnforcement and approved by operator or CTO.
sealingBlockers.B11_unpushedCandidateBlock: Journey cannot collect operator certification runtimeEvidence or reach CERT-SEALED if the candidate code SHA or active machine-state/framework SHA is not present on origin/main.
sealingBlockers.B12_wrongLifecyclePhaseBlock: Journey cannot collect runtimeEvidence, request deploy/APK, or claim certification if the action is being performed in the wrong liveTestingLifecycle phase. Baseline live discovery belongs to PHASE_2. Post-fix runtime certification belongs to PHASE_4. Exploratory testing belongs to PHASE_5 only.

falseSealprevention: CERT-SEALED requires ALL 6 guarantees signed=true with citations.
Each citation must be a file:line reference, not a description.
G1 cannot be signed until every file in scopeFiles has been confirmed read (readings may span sessions; all must be verified and explicitly confirmed in the signing session).
G4 cannot be signed until every touched invariant entry is VERIFIED with file:line.
runtimeEvidence must contain at least one OPERATOR_CONFIRMED entry per action before journey is eligible for CERT-SEALED.
No action can be result=PASS without L2 citations (code path trace) completed.
No journey can be CERT-SEALED without crossPortalMatrix fully verified (all rows have verified=true).

Every runtimeEvidence entry MUST contain all 12 immutable fields in runtimeEvidenceSchema (evidenceType, step, capturedAt, capturedSha, seedVersion, deviceId, storeId, artifactPath, summary, result, actualOutcome, operatorConfirmed). Entries missing capturedSha, seedVersion, deviceId, or storeId are INVALID.
Every accepted-risk waiver MUST be a formal acceptedRisk object with all 8 fields. A freeform notes string is NOT a valid waiver.
Claude CANNOT self-approve (approvedBy=CLAUDE_AUDIT) any waiver where severity=HIGH or severity=CRITICAL. These require approvedBy=OPERATOR or approvedBy=CTO before sealing is permitted.
A code-fix commit that mixed product code with RELEASES/, workflow/state/, or RELEASES/LIVE_TESTING_ISSUES.md is NOT closure-eligible until separated or explicitly waived as a cluster exception.
Operator-confirmed runtime evidence is INVALID unless both the candidate code SHA and active machine-state/framework SHA are pushed to origin/main.
Claude must not switch currentAuditJourney while the active journey is still auditable. Finish the current journey's sealing blockers or document an explicit CERT-BLOCKED stop condition first.
